page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head and page number at the top; the title block (DE MATERIA ET MIXTO, LIBER II.) and the italic argument line above the text. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: DE MATERIA ET MIXTO,
LIBER II.
Voniam Peripatetici in dijudicatione
rerum calidarum & frigidarum, nitun-
tur sensu: nos vero probavimus sensum
de actione calidi, & frigidi, non de
praesentia judicare, calorem nempe
misti, non esse nisi actionem ipsius ignis sensu perce-
ptam; similiter & frigus. Quod Platonis sententia
doctrinaque rationi consentanea comprobatum est,
id ipsum nunc confirmandum est, universae Natu-
rae testimonio; ex quo & ratio litem nobis adjudi-
cet, & multae quaestiones quae hactenus Physicos
Medicosque vexarunt hac positione dirimantur, in
quibus nullus, nisi qui ultra excutire volet, verita-
tem non videat clarissimam.
Probavimus quidem & sole clarius fecimus libro
praecedenti, frigidas in misto partes non esse sine ca-
lidis, nec calidas sine frigidis. Nunc vero addimus
& haec. 1. Ita necessarias esse frigidas calidarum re-
tentioni, ut quo plures fuerint calidae eo, plures fri-
gidae requirantur quae illas involvant 2. Quo me-
lius calidae a frigidis involutae fuerint, si caetera sint
paria, eo firmiorem fore mistionem. 3. Hinc fieri,
ut plurima sint sensu & in extimis frigidissima quae
intus sint calidissima. 4. Quod ex his sequitur, tan-
tum abesse, ut, quod putat Aristoteles, res adustione
partes calidas acquirent; quin contra longe plu-
rimas deperdunt, pauciffimaque retinent, cum aliis
para-

page.notes: The large ornamental initial is V, joined to "oniam" as "Voniam". Long s is normalised to plain s throughout. A small printed asterisk stands at the left beside "Probavimus"; it is not a note and is not transcribed. The word "excutire" is read from a slightly worn letter and is a reasonable but not certain reading. The paragraph ends mid-word at the foot with the catchword "para-", which continues on the next page.
